honest_verdict: complete: deterministic verifier-potential prefix fixture ready

predicate_support.prefix_final_disagreement: exact_final_verdict.accepted is false and any prefix accepted_by_potential
predicate_support.reward_budget: sum deterministic potential and exact-final evaluation costs

prefix_potential_functions.decision_semantics: accept means prefix guidance only, never final safety.
prefix_potential_functions.monotone_scope: required-key coverage over additive prefixes only.
prefix_potential_functions.score_definition: score is present required top-level keys divided by required keys; accept only when all required keys are present
prefix_potential_functions.unknown_prefix_policy: abstain with neutral score 0.0 when no required key is present.

prefix_potential_functions.decision_semantics: accept means the visible pair is consistent only.
prefix_potential_functions.monotone_scope: later fields can introduce a contradiction.
prefix_potential_functions.score_definition: accept when object and negated_object are both present and different; reject when both are present and equal
prefix_potential_functions.unknown_prefix_policy: abstain with neutral score 0.0 until both semantic fields exist.

prefix_potential_functions.decision_semantics: accept does not prove state reachability.
prefix_potential_functions.monotone_scope: tool-name membership is stable once the tool field is emitted.
prefix_potential_functions.score_definition: accept when the visible tool name is in the deterministic allowlist.
prefix_potential_functions.unknown_prefix_policy: abstain with neutral score 0.0 when tool is absent.

prefix_potential_functions.decision_semantics: accept does not prove cross-field arithmetic relations.
prefix_potential_functions.monotone_scope: later numeric fields can violate the finite-domain relation.
prefix_potential_functions.score_definition: accept when all declared finite-domain fields visible so far are integers inside their row-specific bounds
prefix_potential_functions.unknown_prefix_policy: abstain with neutral score 0.0 when no domain field is visible.

prefix_potential_functions.decision_semantics: accept does not prove acyclic ontology update closure.
prefix_potential_functions.monotone_scope: later updates can create a cycle or type conflict.
prefix_potential_functions.score_definition: accept when subject, predicate, and object are visible and match the row ontology type signature
prefix_potential_functions.unknown_prefix_policy: abstain with neutral score 0.0 until triple fields exist.

prefix_potential_functions.decision_semantics: accept does not prove witness signature validity.
prefix_potential_functions.monotone_scope: later witness fields can invalidate the call.
prefix_potential_functions.score_definition: accept when method and path match an allowed deterministic API call.
prefix_potential_functions.unknown_prefix_policy: abstain with neutral score 0.0 until method and path exist.

reward_evaluation_budget.cost_unit: one deterministic verifier-potential or exact-final check invocation
